verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents built-in physics powered by ammo.js, a WebAssembly port of Bullet. It is exposed through rigidbody, collision and joint components, which are available in the Editor, the standalone engine, React and Web Components. That clearly covers rigid bodies and collision shapes. Missing for 10: any evidence of raycast APIs, confirmation that the ammo.js module works with zero setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration of physics behavior.
